name: Invoice
description: Commercial documents issued by a seller to a buyer, relating to a sale transaction and indicating the products, quantities, and agreed prices.

name: Bank Statement
description: Official summaries of financial transactions occurring within a given period on a bank account held by a person or business.

name: Aadhaar Card
description: A 12-digit unique identity number that can be obtained voluntarily by residents or citizens of India, based on their biometric and demographic data.

name: PAN Card
description: Permanent Account Number card, a unique ten-character alphanumeric identifier, issued by the Indian Income Tax Department.

name: Passport
description: An official travel document issued by a government, certifying the holder's identity and citizenship.

name: Insurance Document
description: Official insurance policies, certificates, declarations, or agreements specifying terms and coverage details.
